channel.title: Magick Mastery | The Magick Muse
channel.description: Free witchcraft guides and deep dives from The Magick Muse, sourced from the same published scholarship as the Magick Manuscript.

item.title: Crystals for Beginners: How Witches Choose, Cleanse & Use Them
item.description: Amethyst, citrine, clear quartz, and five more starter stones, plus how to cleanse, charge, and spot fakes before they end up on your altar.

item.title: Astrology for Witches: Timing Spells by Moon & Planets
item.description: You don't need a birth chart to time a spell. The seven planets, moon phases, and moon signs, and how to layer them without obsessing.

item.title: Herbalism for Witches: Working With Plants Safely
item.description: Rose petals for romance, bay leaves for luck. Plant magick is everywhere, and working with it safely starts with knowing your herbs.

item.title: Runes for Beginners: How to Read the Elder Futhark
item.description: Rune doesn't mean letter. It means secret. A grounded introduction to the Elder Futhark, from Odin's ordeal to your first three-rune spread.

item.title: Divination for Beginners: Tarot, Runes & Signs
item.description: Tarot is one tool in a much bigger box. Signs, runes, pendulums, scrying, and more, with a simple way to find the method that fits you.

item.title: Witch Tools for Beginners: What You Need & Your First Altar
item.description: Forget the Pinterest altar. The handful of tools a new witch uses most, and how to set up a working altar in a whole room or a shoebox.

item.title: Ten Years a Witch: What I'd Tell My Beginner Self
item.description: Over ten years of practice, a lot has shifted. What I've unlearned, what I trust now, and what I'd tell my beginner self if I could.

item.title: How to Dispose of a Spell: Wax, Herbs & Spell Jars
item.description: The candle burned out. Now what? Burying, burning, crossroads, running water, and the trash can, matched to the working they came from.

item.title: Ancestor Work for Beginners: Honoring Your Lineage
item.description: Your ancestors are the closest spirits you have. A simple altar, the right offerings, and a real relationship, even without a family tree.

item.title: Deity Work for Beginners: Approaching the Gods
item.description: "Which deity is calling me?" is usually the wrong first question. Approaching gods with patience, research, and respect, and what silence can mean.

item.title: Working With the Greek Gods: Kharis & Offerings
item.description: Kharis is the heart of Hellenic worship: a relationship built on gifts, gratitude, and showing up. Meet the Olympians and start the right way.

item.title: The Law of Similars: Why Like Affects Like in Magick
item.description: Why red for love and green for money? Meet the Law of Similars, the principle behind nearly every spell, and start reading your tools like a witch.

item.title: How to Cast a Spell: Candles, Jars, Sachets & Sigils
item.description: Candles, jars, sachets, and sigils each do something different. How to build each one, and why every spell starts with a clear intention.

item.title: Witchcraft Misinformation: How to Find Reliable Sources
item.description: Black tourmaline protects, or it's dangerous, or it needs a full moon first. Sorting real knowledge from confident guesswork, one red flag at a time.

item.title: How to Research Witchcraft and Find Your Own Answers
item.description: Every book gives a different answer, and so does every website. Research is how a witch cuts through the noise, and anyone can build the skill.

item.title: Meditation for Witches: A Beginner's Guide to Focus
item.description: Meditation doesn't mean an empty mind. Five minutes of breath, a little time outside, and simple grounding can change how your spellwork feels.

item.title: Protection Magick for Beginners: Shields, Wards & Banishing
item.description: Before you manifest anything, protect what you have. Shields, wards, banishing, and the small daily habits that make a protection practice hold.

item.title: What Is a Correspondence in Witchcraft?
item.description: Black tourmaline for protection, Friday for love. A correspondence is energy shared between things, and it's the idea that holds spellwork together.

item.title: Shadow Work for Witches: What It Is & How to Begin
item.description: You can't know anything else until you know yourself. Where shadow work comes from, how it shows up in your craft, and how to start gently.

item.title: Your First Tarot Deck: How to Choose, Cleanse & Read
item.description: You don't have to be gifted your first deck. Choosing one, cleansing and bonding with it, and interviewing it before your first real reading.

item.title: What to Put in a Grimoire: A Look Inside Mine
item.description: A grimoire and a Book of Shadows aren't the same thing. A tour of the sections inside The Magick Manuscript, and how to decide what goes in yours.

item.title: Best Witchcraft Books for Beginners: A Reading List
item.description: Some witchcraft books are excellent and some just have nice covers. A beginner reading list by topic, drawn from the shelf that built the Manuscript.
